title: IFS-1 — Docs Import Folder Source Selection Delivery
summary: deliver the shared folder-picker, dedicated modal, confined source-directory service, and exact Docs Import integration
content_html:
IFS-1 — Docs Import Folder Source Selection Delivery

Status And Purpose

Started as IFS-1 on 2026-08-03 under Docs Import Folder Source Selection. IFS-1.0 and IFS-1.1 are complete. IFS-1.2 is implemented and verified, and the delivery is stopped at its review gate before IFS-1.3 verification and closeout. The Concept And Architecture is the authority for component ownership, modal handoff, confinement, and source-selection behavior.

This delivery establishes an honest shared folder-navigation capability with Docs Viewer as its first consumer, then integrates it into ordinary Docs Import without changing classification, targeting, or apply semantics.

Complete Delivery Outcome

Manage Import shows the current relative source with Choose folder… and Use import staging actions. Choosing opens a dedicated folder-picker modal backed by lazy, server-confined directory listing. Confirming one validated folder restores Import and refreshes its direct-child ordinary candidates; cancelling restores Import unchanged.

The shared frontend component contains only app-neutral folder navigation. A shared Studio Python capability contains only Projects-base confinement and child-directory listing. Docs Viewer explicitly exposes the shared frontend asset, and its Import adapter retains all staging, candidate, recognizer, destination, preview, and apply policy.

Delivery Discipline

  • A shared component may have one initial consumer when its responsibility and dependency direction are genuinely shared.
  • Docs Viewer receives an explicit supported shared-asset boundary; there is no copied or accidental private import.
  • Folder selection has a dedicated modal and deliberate handoff; the existing Import modal does not become a second application view.
  • The Works Editor picker is not migrated merely to manufacture a second consumer.
  • The delivery adds narrow folder navigation and confinement seams, not a generic filesystem framework.

Current Seams And Expected Shape

IFS-1.0 re-traced these seams on 2026-08-03 before implementation:

  • the existing shared frontend file picker and its Works Editor wrapper;
  • Docs Viewer static asset routing and module boot boundaries;
  • the Import modal, controller, candidate inventory, recognizer dispatch, marker paths, preview/apply requests, and local preference patterns;
  • the existing collection-modal handoff and focus-restoration behavior; and
  • shared Studio external-workspace path helpers and Docs Viewer server adapters.

The trace found one material expansion. Current ordinary Import uses the Data Sharing workspace root for both confinement and provider-safe source-path projection. An arbitrary Projects directory must separate those responsibilities so a non-staging preview cannot fall back to a physical path. The frozen estimate is therefore 900–1,230 production lines and 650–950 focused test lines. This is above the proposed 600–850 production and 450–700 test ranges, so IFS-1 stops at this checkpoint for explicit review. The expansion is confined to the existing Import path projection and modal handoff; it does not justify a generic filesystem framework.

Frozen Directory Identity And Confinement

  • The request and browser identity field is source_directory. Its canonical value is a POSIX path relative to $DOTLINEFORM_PROJECTS_BASE_DIR, with no leading or trailing slash. The Projects-base navigation root is the exact marker . and the default is data-sharing/import-staging.
  • Blank values, absolute paths, backslashes, empty segments, parent segments, missing paths, non-directories, and unreadable directories are rejected. . is accepted only as the exact root marker.
  • The configured Projects base is the trust anchor. Every requested relative segment is checked without following a symlink; a symlink in any requested segment is rejected before final containment is confirmed. A direct-child symlink, unreadable directory, or non-directory is omitted from listing rather than exposed.
  • The root is navigable but has current_selectable: false. Every accepted nested real directory has current_selectable: true. The shared browser submits only a server-returned selectable current marker.
  • Validation failure is an HTTP error, not a server-side silent redirect. The browser owns remembered-source recovery: it clears the invalid preference, validates data-sharing/import-staging, and retries candidate listing without changing destination.

Frozen Docs Import HTTP Contract

GET /docs/import-source-directories?source_directory=<marker> lists one validated directory lazily:

{
  "ok": true,
  "current_directory": "projects/architecture",
  "current_selectable": true,
  "parent_directory": "projects",
  "directories": [
    {
      "label": "references",
      "source_directory": "projects/architecture/references"
    }
  ]
}

At source_directory=., parent_directory is null and current_selectable is false. Directory rows contain only a display label and canonical relative marker.

GET /docs/import-source-files?source_directory=<marker> keeps the existing body-free candidates and files projections and adds the canonical accepted source_directory. The field is required by the current client. Candidate discovery is one level deep and standalone media remains ignored.

POST /docs/import-source keeps the existing exact destination fields and requires:

{
  "scope": "studio",
  "source_directory": "projects/architecture",
  "staged_filename": "notes.md"
}

sub_scope, prompt metadata, preview, collision, and collection fields retain their current meanings. The server resolves the directory and then the direct-child filename on every request. A missing, moved, symlinked, nested, traversal, changed-format, or otherwise mismatched pair fails before preview or apply.

Registered collection and edited-review recognizers inspect the untouched direct child before generic suffix or Markdown-package handling. Inside data-sharing/import-staging, trusted candidates retain the existing integrated workflow. Outside staging, a recognized trusted package or edited review source is returned as a blocked candidate with the trusted_source_requires_import_staging diagnostic, and direct POST receives the same staging-only error. It never falls through as an ordinary document. A normal directory containing exactly one Markdown document remains an ordinary Markdown-package candidate, and that candidate directory remains the media-resolution root.

Frozen Shared Folder Picker And Asset Boundary

The shared export is:

createFolderPicker(root, {
  initialDirectory,
  loadDirectory,
  onSubmit,
})

loadDirectory({directory}) supplies the frozen directory-list response. onSubmit({directory}) receives only the current server-returned selectable marker. The returned controller exposes ready, focusPreferred(), getDirectory(), submit(), and destroy(). The component owns breadcrumb and parent/direct-child navigation, loading, empty/error presentation, list keyboard behavior, and submit validation. It contains no route, storage key, Projects-base, staging, candidate, destination, or Docs Import knowledge.

The module and component-owned styles are shared/frontend/js/folder-picker.js and shared/frontend/css/folder-picker.css, using the .sharedFolderPicker namespace. Docs Viewer exposes only these exact supported URLs:

/docs-viewer/runtime/js/shared-frontend/folder-picker.js
/docs-viewer/static/css/shared-folder-picker.css

Import source controls remain under .docsViewerImport in docs-viewer-import.css. The existing shared file-picker module, configuration, styles, and Works wrapper are unchanged.

Frozen Modal, Preference, And Fallback Contract

  • The storage key is dotlineform-docs-import-source-directory. It is global to local Docs Import rather than scope-keyed because source and destination are independent. The value is one canonical server-returned nested marker; absent means import staging. Storage read/write/remove failures are treated as an unavailable preference, not an Import failure.
  • Opening Import reads the preference, revalidates it through the directory endpoint, and only then lists candidates for the accepted marker. Invalid state is removed before staging is validated and listed. If staging itself is unavailable, the existing Import error/status owner reports the failure.
  • Choose folder… suspends Import without restoring focus, opens docsViewerImportFolderModal, and initializes the shared picker at the accepted current source. Navigation failure stays in that modal. Cancel closes the folder modal, restores Import unchanged, and focuses the Choose launcher.
  • Confirm submits one selectable server-returned marker, closes the folder modal without independent destination state, restores Import, refreshes candidates for the exact marker, and focuses the Choose launcher. The accepted marker becomes visible even if candidate refresh later fails; the existing Import status/retry owner reports that failure.
  • The preference is written only after server acceptance. Use import staging validates and refreshes data-sharing/import-staging, then removes the preference and returns focus to its own launcher. Neither action changes the frozen parent or sub-scope destination.
  • Closing the restored Import modal still returns focus to the original Manage Import launcher. The folder modal cannot preview, apply, select files, retain a destination, or create a second Import identity.

Rough Diff Estimate And Expansion Gate

slice production tests signal
IFS-1.1 420–580 lines 350–500 lines one shared resolver plus explicit source identity through the current server path

The increase from the proposed estimate comes from the confirmed Data Sharing path-projection coupling and the existing multi-owner modal composition. Crossing 1,230 production lines, altering the Works picker, adding recursive discovery, introducing a generic filesystem abstraction, or changing trusted-package semantics beyond the staging gate is a fresh stop-and-review signal.

IFS-1.0 Review Scenarios

The frozen contract covers:

  • default staging with no stored preference;
  • one accepted nested Projects folder and direct-child ordinary document;
  • one direct-child directory containing exactly one Markdown document plus relative media;
  • missing, unreadable, or invalid remembered state clearing before staging fallback;
  • blank, absolute, traversal, and per-segment symlink requests;
  • a trusted package or edited review source outside staging remaining blocked;
  • cancel and confirm restoring Import and the exact Choose launcher while retaining the original Manage launcher for final close; and
  • direct serving and module loading of only the two named shared assets.

No IFS-1.1 implementation begins until this checkpoint and its expanded estimate are accepted.

Delivery Steps

IFS-1.0 — Trace And Freeze Boundaries

  • [x] Confirm this delivery ID and title before implementation edits and keep unrelated Docs Import or Works Editor work outside the slice.
  • [x] Trace the current shared file picker, Works wrapper, Docs Viewer static routes, Import state owner, modal handoff, recognizer-first candidate path, marker construction, exact preview/apply binding, confinement helpers, and browser-preference conventions.
  • [x] Freeze the shared component API and CSS ownership, the explicit Docs Viewer shared-asset route, dedicated modal lifecycle and focus handoff, server operation names and payloads, remembered-storage key, staging fallback, symlink policy, trusted-format behavior, and exact source binding.
  • [x] Record exact proposed files, reused owners, production/test diff estimates, and any expansion before implementation approval.

Checkpoint: one reviewed contract covers staging, a normal nested Projects folder, a one-document Markdown package, invalid and missing remembered folders, traversal and symlink attempts, a trusted package outside staging, cancel/confirm focus restoration, and explicit serving of the shared asset. Stop for review before IFS-1.1.

IFS-1.1 — Shared Confinement And Docs Import API

  • [x] Add one shared Studio Python resolver/lister that returns canonical base-relative directory markers and validated direct-child directories without import-specific policy.
  • [x] Add the Docs Viewer directory-list operation and parameterize ordinary candidate inventory by a validated source directory while preserving recognizer-first classification and body-free rows.
  • [x] Keep trusted returned-package and edited review-source intake staging-only; never downgrade a recognized trusted candidate outside staging to ordinary Import.
  • [x] Bind candidate selection, preview, and apply to the exact {source_directory, staged_filename} pair and reject stale, changed, or mismatched inputs.
  • [x] Preserve a Markdown-package candidate's own directory as its media root and keep all absolute paths out of responses and diagnostics.

Checkpoint: focused resolver, candidate-inventory, recognizer, API, and exact-binding tests pass for accepted and rejected locations before frontend integration.

IFS-1.1 Evidence

  • With a valid temporary Projects bootstrap supplied for collection, python3 -m pytest studio/tests/python/test_projects_directories.py docs-viewer/tests/python/test_docs_management_routes.py docs-viewer/tests/python/test_docs_import_source_directories.py docs-viewer/tests/python/test_docs_import_source_listing.py docs-viewer/tests/python/test_docs_import_sub_scope.py docs-viewer/tests/python/test_docs_import_media_packages.py docs-viewer/tests/python/test_docs_management_import_target.py docs-viewer/tests/python/test_docs_document_package_service.py passed 117 tests with one existing skip.
  • The broader test_docs_import_source_*.py plus test_docs_import_media_packages.py regression passed 72 tests, covering DOCX, HTML, ordinary formats, trusted review sources, and current staging behavior.
  • bin/lint --scope docs-viewer, bin/lint --scope studio, bin/lint --scope tests, and git diff --check passed.
  • Successful payloads were inspected for Projects-relative provenance only. Focused failures cover blank/noncanonical markers, root selection, traversal, missing and moved sources, nested filenames, requested and child symlinks, unreadable children, and staging-only returned-package and edited-review intake.
  • The implementation shape is 384 production additions and 51 deletions, below the frozen 420–580 production estimate, plus 499 test additions and 33 deletions within the frozen 350–500 test estimate. The production file set stayed exact. Small test-only fixture/assertion updates outside the proposed list were required for the newly mandatory request field and Projects-relative low-level DOCX projection.
  • IFS-1.2 remains unstarted. No shared frontend asset, browser preference, Import source control, static route, modal handoff, focus behavior, remembered fallback, or realistic UI presentation was implemented or accepted in this checkpoint. No live HTTP/browser smoke is claimed; route ownership and dispatch were exercised at the Python service boundary.

IFS-1.2 — Shared Folder Picker And Dedicated Modal

  • [x] Add the app-neutral shared folder-picker module and component-owned styles with injected load and submit behavior.
  • [x] Expose the shared frontend asset to Docs Viewer through one explicit supported route or build boundary and cover that boundary with a route/module test.
  • [x] Add the dedicated folder-picker modal and controller handoff: suspend Import, navigate lazily, confirm or cancel, restore Import, and return focus to the launcher.
  • [x] Add Import's current-source display, Choose folder…, and Use import staging actions without moving destination, candidate, status, preview/apply, or result ownership out of Import.
  • [x] Persist only a server-accepted canonical marker in local browser state, revalidate on every Import session, and clear invalid state before falling back to staging.
  • [x] Leave the Works Editor file picker unchanged.

Checkpoint: focused browser-module and manual UI checks cover loading, empty/error state, direct-child navigation, breadcrumb/parent navigation, keyboard/focus behavior, confirm, cancel, staging reset, remembered revalidation, and realistic modal density.

IFS-1.2 Evidence

  • python3 -m pytest docs-viewer/tests/python/test_docs_viewer_static_assets.py -q passed 11 tests with a temporary Projects base supplied for service collection. The exact shared module and stylesheet routes, path mapping, asset versioning, shell load, and absence of a whole-tree shared route are covered.
  • docs_import_folder_source_modules.py, docs_viewer_modal_focus_modules.py, docs_import_multi_selection_modules.py, and docs_viewer_consolidated_import_route.py all passed. These checks cover loading, empty and error states, direct-child and breadcrumb/parent navigation, keyboard active selection, selectable-marker submission, invalid remembered-source fallback, staging reset, dedicated-modal suspend/restore, final Manage launcher focus, and exact source_directory in ordinary and collection POST bodies.
  • bin/lint-js passed for all nine changed JavaScript production files. bin/lint --scope docs-viewer, bin/lint --scope studio, bin/lint --scope tests, changed-file Python compilation, git diff --check, and the focused sensitive-value scan passed; the scan returned only existing field/test-token identifiers and no embedded path or credential value.
  • Manual acceptance used an isolated current-code Docs Viewer service at 127.0.0.1:8796; an already-running older process was excluded after its new static route returned 404. Import displayed data-sharing/import-staging, the picker loaded the accepted current marker, parent and Projects-root navigation returned direct-child rows, Home/End changed the active descendant, root submission stayed in the modal with a validation status, and cancel and confirm restored Import with focus on Choose folder… after refresh. Use import staging retained the default source and its own focus; final Import close returned focus to the Manage Import launcher.
  • Light and dark presentation were inspected at 1280×720 with realistic Studio navigation and candidate density. The dedicated modal reused the existing reserved card space without clipping or overflow, and the browser console had no warnings or errors. The temporary theme change and local staging preference were restored after acceptance.
  • The retained IFS-1.2 shape is 718 production additions and 9 deletions, plus 461 focused-test additions and 2 deletions. The production slice is 28 lines above its revised 505–690 working estimate, while combined IFS-1.1 and IFS-1.2 production additions are 1,102, below the frozen 1,230 stop signal. Focused tests are 10 lines above the rough total range because the dedicated modal focus boundary and explicit keyboard selection state are both protected. The approved production-file expansion is limited to the two existing request-body owners above.
  • IFS-1.3 remains unstarted. This checkpoint did not apply a non-staging import, reverify the trusted-format staging gate end to end, update the durable Docs Import current-state documents, or claim delivery closeout.

IFS-1.3 — Verification And Closeout

  • [ ] Verify root confinement, traversal and per-segment symlink rejection, direct-child listing, format filtering, recognizer-first behavior, stale selection, remembered fallback, and exact preview/apply source binding.
  • [ ] Verify ordinary file and one-document Markdown-package imports from staging and one non-staging directory into parent and configured sub-scope destinations, including relative media resolution.
  • [ ] Verify a trusted format outside staging remains blocked, absolute paths do not leak, source inputs remain untouched, and default staging behavior is unchanged.
  • [ ] Run focused service, API, route/module, browser smoke, lint, whitespace, and final-diff checks, then complete manual modal handoff acceptance.
  • [ ] Rebuild Studio Docs and search, then update Docs Import and Docs Import Architecture with shipped current-state behavior only after acceptance.

Completion checkpoint: retain command-level and realistic UI evidence for every claim, identify untested surfaces and omissions, and do not mark the delivery complete before the durable current-state documents own the accepted behavior.

Not In Scope

  • recursive search, whole-tree candidate expansion, multi-selection, batch apply, jobs, progress, or resumable corpus migration;
  • PRJ-2 Apple Notes migration or folder_path assignment;
  • trusted package or edited review-source intake outside import staging;
  • native operating-system folder access or paths outside the Projects base;
  • a Works Editor picker migration or requirement for a second consumer;
  • new source formats, media rules, destination selection, or overwrite rules;
  • copying, moving, deleting, or synchronizing source material; or
  • server-wide or multi-user preference synchronization.

Completion Evidence

  • Import staging remains the default and preserves existing behavior when no alternate source is selected.
  • Every selected and remembered source is server-resolved beneath $DOTLINEFORM_PROJECTS_BASE_DIR and represented outside the server by a relative marker only.
  • The shared frontend capability is explicitly reachable by Docs Viewer, contains no Docs Import policy, and works through the dedicated modal handoff.
  • Ordinary candidates retain existing classification, conversion, exact destination, create-only, media, and rebuild behavior.
  • Trusted formats cannot bypass staging or fall through to ordinary Import.
  • Invalid remembered folders fail closed to staging without changing the current destination.
  • No recursive, batch-import, generic-filesystem, or Works Editor migration capability is introduced.
